notes.title: [Update] Resource weekly change details panel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40864706/30e78dc731460cd4ea91a48d70084566eb732095.png[/img]
Now click on the HUD in the upper left corner, it will display the weekly quantity changes of the item, specific to each type of building. Click the search button to switch among such buildings to make adjustments.

notes.title: 【Update】Customizing HUD display items
notes.content:
Update:
-Support customizing the items displayed in the HUD. Click the icon in the warehouse to select.
-Support choosing which foods are allowed to be eaten by villagers and which foods are not allowed (usually intermediate products in the industry chain).
-The statistical method of the weekly delta number of the items in the HUD has been changed. It used to be the actual amount of change of the item from last week to this week, but the players reported that the items used for this construction were also included in the statistics, making it inconvenient to adjust the industry line. So now it is changed to the sum of the average weekly delta number of all buildings and the number of market transactions delta number related to this item .

Update plan for the next week:
-Use an interface to display the details of the increase or decrease of the number of items.
-Fix the errors in the current statistics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40864706/bc260513ab2d570fbae79a2ca24d8839d74f7437.png[/img]

notes.title: 【Small Update】New Fuction：Building range display，setting frame rate
notes.content:
Update:
1. Display the area occupied by the building during construction
2. When a building is selected, its function range is displayed. Currently supports logging camp and market.
3. Support custom setting frame rate.
4. Support for 3440*1440 resolution.

notes.title: [Small Update]Optimize loading time
notes.content:
By optimizing the code, the loading time is significantly reduced. A save file with 4000 population takes 5 minutes to load before optimization and only 13 seconds after optimization.
Great news!

notes.title: [Small update] Support for changing resolution
notes.content: At the request of the majority of players, the functions of changing the resolution, switching windowing and full screen have been updated. Modify it in the settings of the main menu.
